text.d: Form labels, alert and list titles

sets.d: Brand logos. EuvinoPRO = company logo. WIN = product mark with the “by EuvinoPRO” endorsement (toggle Endorsement), as on the WIN prototype. Inverse = for dark backgrounds (footer, dark bands).
Text input. Optional left icon and Clear (x) icon. For choosing from a list use Dropdown.
Select field. State Default, Hover, Expanded (shows the open menu of _Dropdown Option rows; each option is exposed: set its state, e.g. Selected), Disabled. Option 4/5 toggles for shorter menus.
One option in an open Dropdown menu. State Default, Hover, Selected (violet tint + check), Disabled. Optional left icon.
Checkbox control in default, hover, focus and disabled states.
Checkbox with a text label.
Round radio button with status colours.
Radio button with a text label.
Switch. State Default, Hover, Focus, Disabled × Position Off/On. 44×24 pill (size/toggle-width × size/control-xs), 20px white thumb. For a labelled switch use Toggle + Text.
Toggle with a label. State × Text Side (Left = switch first). The Toggle is exposed: set Position Off/On from the instance.
Numeric stepper with increase and decrease buttons.
Multi-line text entry. Use for comments and descriptions; use Input for single-line values.
Pick a value on a range. Show the value when precision matters; use Input when an exact number is required.
Drag-and-drop area for files. State the accepted types and size limit in the description.
One uploaded file with its progress, result and a remove action.
Enter several values as removable tags. Built on Chips.
One day in the Calendar.
Month grid for picking a date or range. Each day is a _Calendar Day instance.
Input plus Calendar. Use for dates near today; use Input for known dates such as birthdays.

Styles: CTA = orange call to action from euvinopro.eu (.btn-orange, #FF6B35, hover #E85520), one per view. Filled = violet primary action. Outline and Clear = secondary actions. Sizes Giant 56 to Tiny; states Default, Hover, Focus, Press, Disabled.

Switches between 2–4 views or filters of the same content in place (Liste / Raster, Tag / Woche). One segment is always Selected: set it on the exposed Segments. Not for page navigation (Navbar) or content panels (Tab). Replaces the kit’s Button Group. Adapted from the Tracka design system with EuvinoPRO tokens.

One option of a Segmented control. Exactly one segment is Selected. Use the Segmented control set and set each exposed segment’s Label, Icon and Selected. Adapted from the Tracka design system with EuvinoPRO tokens.
Selectable chips for filters and tags.
Top navigation bar of Top Nav Items (navy only). Every item is exposed: set Label and State; toggle Item 4–7 for 3–7 links.
One top-navigation link: navy label, 2px navy underline when Selected (border/strong on Hover). Local version of the kit’s _Tab Item.
Breadcrumb trail of 2–5 items. Each Item is exposed: select the group instance and edit any item’s State, Label and icons in the right panel.
One breadcrumb. Set State, Label, and turn the left/right icons on or off (or swap them). Inside Breadcrumbs (Group) every item is exposed, so it can be edited from the group instance.
Pagination item (kit design): 48px circle. Default violet number, Hover violet tint, Focus violet ring, Selected violet fill with white number, Disabled grey. Content Text or Icon.
Pagination bar: previous, page numbers, next. Every item is exposed: set its number and state (Selected for the current page).

Profile / account trigger for the Top Bar. Toggle Avatar, Name (name + subtitle block), Subtitle and Chevron to get: avatar only, name only, avatar + name, etc. Avatar is exposed: switch Type (Image, Letter, Icon) from the instance.
One step in a process. Turn Connector off on the last step.
Shows progress through a multi-step process. Change each exposed step to Complete, Current, Upcoming or Error.
Action or context menu built from _Dropdown Option. Use for commands; use Dropdown for choosing a value.
User avatar as image, letter or icon, with optional status dot.
Small label for status, count or category.
Leading part of a list row: icon, avatar or image.
Trailing part of a list row: text, badge, icon or toggle.
Product image tile for tables and lists. Rounded square (radius/lg) on bg/muted with a hairline. Drop a product photo in as a fill, or keep the icon placeholder.
Short hint shown on hover or focus.
Separates groups of content. Prefer spacing first; add a line only when spacing is not enough.
Several people in a small space. Show at most 4 and collapse the rest into the count.
Shown when there is nothing to display. Say why and offer the next action.
Placeholder while content loads. Match the layout that will appear; use Loader when the layout is unknown.
One event in a Timeline. Turn Connector off on the last item.
Chronological list of events, such as request history.
One expandable row. Title and chevron share a colour in each state.
Stacked expandable sections. Use when users need only some of the content.

Bar chart. Orientation Vertical/Horizontal; Mode Grouped, Stacked, Diverging (positive/negative). Series 1–5 toggles (colours chart/1–5), Grid and Axis toggles. Resize width freely; plot height = size/chart-md. Bar lengths are sample data.
Line chart: Series 1–4 (chart/1–4), dashed Comparison line (chart/6), Points, Grid, Axis, Legend toggles. Resize freely; lines scale. Values are sample data.
Pie / Donut / Thin donut with 2–6 segments (chart/1–6). Center value and Legend toggles. Chart size = size/chart-md. Segment sizes are sample data.
Radial progress rings, 1–5 rings (chart/1–5 on bg/muted tracks), Legend toggle. Ring values are sample data.
Half-circle gauge, Value 0–100 in steps of 10 (chart/1 on bg/muted). Label text + toggle.
List of labelled progress bars with value and trend. Row 4–6 toggles; each Progress Bar is exposed (set its percent). Built from Progress Bar.
KPI stat: label (optional dropdown), value, trend delta. Trend Up = status/success, Down = status/error, None hides the delta.
Legend entry: series swatch (chart/1–6) + label.
Horizontal progress bar with optional percentage.
Modal dialog with text, optional input and buttons.
Inline message for info, success, warning or error.
Text-only button for secondary actions.
Short message that confirms an action and disappears by itself. Use Alert for messages that must stay.
Focused task above the page, with a free content area. Use Pop-Up for short confirmations.
Side panel for details or edits while keeping the page in view.
Small panel attached to a control, with richer content than a Tooltip.
Indeterminate loading indicator. Use Skeleton when the layout is known and Progress Bar when the duration is known.

Data card for every chart. Swap Chart to Bar, Line, Donut, Radial, Gauge or Progress List (each keeps its own options: series, legend, grid…). Toggle Description, Segmented control, Menu, Stats (Stat 4–5). Title and description are properties.
Data quality summary: score, Progress Bar, Legend Items.
Recent requests card built from Request Items.
Quick links card built from List (Left Item).
Avatar beside title and description.
Centred avatar above title and description.
Title and description with a date and a badge.
Thumbnail beside title, description and a row of badges.
Titled list of rows with a trailing text.
Two titled groups, each with a row of badges.
Bordered card with thumbnail, title and badges.
Title and description with a donut chart.
Avatar, title, text and timestamp.
Title with progress bar and description.
Bordered card with thumbnail, text and a button.
Colour block, title, progress bar and a button.
Header with author avatar, text and image.
Title, description and badge beside a tall image.
Title and description above a short avatar list.
Part label, large number, title and two paragraphs.
Title and subtitle above a list of key and value rows.
Avatar, title, description and a row of badges.
Title and description above a 2 by 2 image grid.
Image on top with title and description.
Avatar header, image, text and two buttons.

App header in 3 sizes: Small 56 (size/header-sm), Medium 64, Large 72. Inner atoms scale with it: Brand Logo S/M/L, icon Buttons Small/Medium/Large, Input Medium/Large, User Menu S/M/L (avatar 32/40/48). Toggle Brand, Title, Nav, Search, Actions, User menu; exposed instances keep their own options.
Title slot used inside Header.

Left site navigation. Content: Icon + Text, Text only, or Icon only (collapsed rail, size/sidebar-collapsed). Toggle Counters and Help card. Every Nav item is exposed: set its state, label, icon, or hide it from the instance.
Page title, subtitle and primary action Button.
Table only. Rows: 3–10. Column 1 = Checkbox + Text (header checkbox selects all). Column 2–8 toggles. Row N selected: bg/accent-subtle tint + violet indicator. Built from Table Cell.

Generic table cell for any table. Type: Header (with sort icon), Text, Text + Subtext, Thumbnail + Text, Badge, Action. Align Left/Right. Text and Subtext are properties; toggle Subtext, Sort icon and Divider. Thumbnail, Badge and Action are exposed instances. Set width per column (Fill or fixed).
Page footer with legal text and links. Sits at the bottom of the screen shell.
